messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: SRE oncall triggered for P1 - high error rate and fallback loop observed for tenant `shoply` (hosted -> dedicated spillover). See alert: https://alerts.internal/re/1713337777 :rotating_light:
alex: seeing a spike in 502s from the routing service. Dashboard shows repeated retries to dedicated pool B despite capacity available in hosted.
maria: confirmed — policy engine is issuing 'force_dedicated' for requests that should stay hosted. looks like a model_variant tag got injected (variant: "dedicated-v2-quant") when it should be "hosted-v1".
oncall-sre: I'm on it. grabbing logs from router and policy-mgr now. tagging support for customer comms @product-ops
jenn: customer ops note: top-10 p95 latency for shoply's requests jumped from 120ms -> 1.8s, and ~12% of tokens routed to dedicated where they pay higher per-token cost. shoply is on Dedicated opt-out but still shouldn't be spilled.
incidents-bot: Recent deploy detected to policy-service at 1713337000 by infra-cd - rolling back recommended if correlated.
alex: timeline looks like deploy + policy config rollout. policy-service v2.1.4 includes new heuristics for aggressive spillover when tail latency crosses threshold. config for 'tenant_isolation' may be mis-evaluating tenant tags.
maria: snippet from router logs (cut):
```
2026-04-05T12:02:31Z router: req_id=abc123 tenant=shoply route=decide chosen_pool=dedicated pool_tag=dedicated-v2-quant reason=policy(force_dedicated) policy_eval={latency_est: 1800, tenant_quota: ok, variant_hint: dedicated}
```
samir: that variant_hint looks wrong — where is variant_hint injected? could be model-onboard metadata or a bad mapping in the catalog.
oncall-sre: I can flip a temporary mitigation: add a routing override to pin shoply to hosted pools for the next 30m. Would that be acceptable?
alex: yes, do it. create a soft override first (no restart) and monitor. Command to add override (infra-run):
```
infractl routing override create --tenant shoply --pool hosted --ttl 1800 --reason "incident: misvariant spillover"
```
jenn: please cc me when override is in. I'll draft a quick note to the customer with ETA and actions.
oncall-sre: running infractl now...
oncall-sre: done — override created. router logs now show decisions to hosted for new requests. watching for backfill.
maria: can we also disable the new spillover heuristic in policy-service? if it's the root cause, rollback or feature flag off would be safer.
alex: feature flag exists. toggling off for rollout id 2026-04-policy-heuristics.
incidents-bot: feature-flag service: toggle succeeded for rollout id 2026-04-policy-heuristics - state: OFF
samir: good. I'm pulling model-catalog change history. there was a mapping update that accidentally set default_variant for tenants with label "enterprise-tier" to dedicated-v2-quant. shoply has that label.
product-ops: action item: review label->variant mapping; prevent global mapping without tenant-level opt-in.
alex: mitigation checklist: 1) routing override (done) 2) feature flag off (done) 3) rollback mapping (in progress) 4) run smoke tests to ensure no further spillover.
jenn: customer comms ready: short note saying we've mitigated, root cause investigation in progress, estimated full RCA in 4 hrs. sending now.
maria: rolling back the catalog mapping now.
maria: rollback succeeded, catalog vtag 2026-04-05-rc1 -> previous 2026-03-30-stable.
oncall-sre: monitoring — error rate down to baseline, p95 latency back to ~140ms for shoply, dedicated token % back to normal.
samir: collecting artifacts for RCA: policy server logs, catalog diff, routing decisions, infractl override, feature flag change.
product-ops: prioritizing follow-up: add an automated test to validate label->variant mappings on catalog updates and require explicit tenant opt-in for overrides.
alex: post-incident tasks (owners): samir - catalog test PR, maria - add policy regression test + canary, oncall-sre - document runbook for routing override, jenn - customer postmortem draft.
incidents-bot: Incident P1 resolved -> mitigations applied and verified. Creating incident ticket INC-1713337777 and scheduling RCA meeting in 2 hours. :white_check_mark:
jenN: thanks everyone. quick note: we should also check billing impact for shoply for the window. finance alert will need numbers.
jenn: noted — pulling cost delta and will attach to RCA.
product-ops: closing the loop: ensure we keep the infractl override TTLs short and prefer config rollbacks.
maria: one-liner RCA draft: "Catalog label mapping regression caused tenant-level variant_hint to be set to a dedicated model variant, triggering policy heuristic to spill requests to dedicated pools. Combined with a recent feature rollout for aggressive spill heuristics, this caused a cascading fallback loop. Mitigation: routing override, feature-flag toggle, catalog rollback."
alex: good draft. I'll add timelines and link artifacts.
incidents-bot: note: pager handoff scheduled to next oncall at 1713339000 per rota.
product-ops: closing thread — will post RCA and the follow-up tickets in INC-1713337777. :handshake:
